title: ReIG2 / twinRIG / ReIG-DQ Research: Audited Dissipative-Quantum Core and Publication Architecture Update
description: ReIG is a research program spanning legacy ReIG2/twinRIG resonance models, later ReIG3/RIF extensions, applications, and audited mathematical work. The August 2026 release distinguishes these layers explicitly. ReIG-DQ (Reconstructed Design Theory for Dissipative Quantum Systems) is the audited finite-dimensional dissipative-quantum mathematical core organized as T-DQ-01 through T-DQ-05 plus the Identity Bridge. A separate Publication Architecture provides frozen artifacts, independent-verifier provenance, SHA-256 integrity ledgers, bilingual synchronization, and GitHub/Zenodo release coordination. Legacy ReIG2 resonance-operator code and philosophical/experimental models are preserved as historical research context and should not be conflated with the frozen ReIG-DQ theorem core unless an explicit dependency is documented.
